content: shellhub: centralized SSH gateway for NAT traversal - device agent dials OUT and holds reverse tunnel, browser->gateway(TLS)->server(merged Go monolith: api+ssh+admin)->tunnel->agent->local shell; sessions are SSH connections, NO live-session persistence across disconnects (only audit metadata + asciinema-style recordings persist, replayable in web UI); wsconnadapter adapts WS to net.Conn. gotty (yudai, Go): Go port of ttyd model - one process spawned per WS connection via creack/pty + gorilla/websocket, hterm/xterm.js frontend, no detach/multi-attach (fetch of repo failed, model from training - MEDIUM confidence).
